name: Transport workspace multimodal legs, delay propagation, and cargo manifesting

planSteps.description: Navigate to /transport on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Transport Legs workspace header 'Transport Legs - Multimodal transit corridors, fleet movement, and operational delay tracking' is visible
Verify search input, transport mode dropdown, and status filter buttons are present
Click on a transport leg code chip or row to open the TransportLegDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays leg overview with mode badge, schedule dates, and capacity
Verify manifested cargo list renders and provides 'Manifest Cargo' workflow button
Verify 'Operational Delay Propagation' section with 'Record Delay' button and state transition selector are present
